title: Student adaptation to college and coping in relation to adjustment during COVID-19: A machine learning approach
summary: The study applies machine-learning classifiers to a survey of 517 US students collected during the initial COVID-19 peak and reports average AUC 0.91 across five adjustment domains, with SHAP feature analysis of coping/stress predictors. This is a bounded behavioral prediction result; it does not establish causal effects or generalize beyond the sampled survey. Validation and limitations are bounded in the decision reason.
